prompt:
Edit the provided Neon Exorcist player concept with ONLY these design changes, preserving the same male character, hair and topknot, fitted short technical jacket, ritual talismans, black technical fabric, highly detailed realistic game concept art style, neutral full-body pose and gray studio background.
1. OVERSIZED BOOTS: make both boots conspicuously oversized chunky cyberpunk combat boots, approximately 35 percent wider and larger with very thick layered soles, bulky reinforced toe boxes, armored ankle cuffs and substantial fasteners. They should feel intentionally exaggerated and heavy while the man's body stays human-proportioned. Show both boots entirely, without cropping.
2. HALF-FACE VISOR INSTEAD OF FACE MASK: completely remove the full-face spirit mask. Replace it with a sleek wraparound holographic visor covering only the eyes and upper half of his face. Include a small central angular nose shield extending from the visor bridge down over the nose, stopping above the upper lip. Clearly expose his human mouth, lower cheeks, chin and jaw. The visor has an amber-tinted translucent lens, cyan/magenta edge accents, and fine supernatural circuit detail. It must read as wearable eyewear with a nose guard, NOT a full faceplate or helmet.
3. ADD ORANGE AND YELLOW: integrate strong neon tangerine orange and electric golden yellow accents across the visor, jacket shoulders and chest, forearms, trouser panels, talismans and oversized boots. Keep portions of the existing cyan and magenta accents for a coordinated vibrant multicolor design. Warm orange/yellow should be prominent, balanced against black fabric and existing cool neon, with controlled emissive glow, crisp surface detail and subtle colored bounce light.
Maintain the clear fitted jacket silhouette, character identity and single-character composition. Full-body head-to-boot framing, same portrait composition, clean dark gray studio backdrop, no text, no logos, no watermark, no additional panels or characters.
